questions.stem: A 35 year old man tall and thin built present to casualty with sudden onset dyspnea .Upon examination no air entry on right side of lung and affected area was hyperresonant on percussion. Following which immediate bed side USG was done and findings are positive for pneumothorax. Which is incorrect about USG done in thoracic disease?

options.label: A
options.text: visualisation of chest wall requires a high frequency linear probe

options.label: B
options.text: Visualisation of pleural and pulmonary disease is better detected with a sector probe with a lower frequency.

options.label: C
options.text: Pneumothorax is suggested by seashore sign on m mode USG

options.label: D
options.text: Pneumothorax is suggested by stratosphere sign on m mode USG
